about.title: We build the CRM we always wished we had.
about.lead: We're a small European team of engineers and salespeople who believe a good CRM should fade into the background of real work, not add friction.
about.body: We've worked at B2B startups and multilingual agencies where sales tools were heavy, expensive and never truly localized. So we built one differently: open source, AI-native, multilingual from day one, with European privacy at its core. Gallo CRM is our answer — an honest copilot for people who sell.
about.missionBody: Empower every sales team — from solo founders to enterprise crews — to close more deals with a tool that speaks their language, respects their data, and grows with them.

pricing.heroTitle: Pricing that scales with your sales team.
pricing.heroSubtitle: Start free with two seats. Upgrade when you need power features, billed monthly or yearly via Stripe.
pricing.compareSubtitle: Everything in Free, plus what you unlock on each tier.

1.q: Can I really use the Free plan forever?
1.a: Yes. The Free plan is fully featured for up to two users with no time limit and no credit card.

2.q: What happens when I add a third user?
2.a: You'll be asked to upgrade an admin to Standard or Premium before the new user can register. Existing users keep working without interruption.

3.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
3.a: All major credit and debit cards via Stripe Checkout. SEPA and bank transfer are available on yearly plans on request.

4.a: Yes. Cancel from the Stripe Customer Portal. Your workspace stays on the paid plan until the end of the current period, then downgrades to Free.

5.a: Absolutely. We are AGPL-3.0 open source. Export your data anytime; on cancellation we keep it for 30 days for accidental-undelete, then erase on request.

6.q: How does the AI scoring work?
6.a: Each lead gets a 0-100 score based on filled fields, logged activities and historical context. We use an advanced AI model for reasoning with a heuristic fallback if the provider is offline. Fully transparent: you always see which model answered and on what data.

7.a: Yes. The source is public under AGPL-3.0. Clone the repo, run docker compose up, and your instance is live in 5 minutes. We ship up-to-date Docker images you can deploy on any Docker host.

8.a: Stripe for billing, WhatsApp Business for messaging, plus a REST API and outgoing webhooks for custom integrations. Email and calendar sync, Slack and more are on the public roadmap.

9.a: Yes. EU data residency, at-rest and in-transit encryption, immutable audit logs, self-service export and right-to-erasure implemented. A Data Processing Agreement is available on Premium plans.

10.a: Email support with a 4-business-hour response target, a 90-minute guided onboarding session, and a dedicated account manager for teams of 10+.
